concepts.gloss_en: The six weekdays — specifically counted as six, equated with the six orders of Mishnah (in Torah 79)

members.note: representative; the six-fold count is essential, tied to ששה סדרי משנה

concepts.gloss_en: The weekdays — as an aspect of Yetzirah/formation (in Torah 66); no six-fold enumeration

members.note: different construct head (lacks ששת); different Torah, associated with בחינת יצירה rather than the six orders of Mishnah

notes: Different construct heads (ששת ימי החל vs ימי החל) and different Torah contexts (79 vs 66) with distinct symbolic mappings — six orders of Mishnah vs Yetzirah. Kept separate per under-merge preference; a reviewer may consider these the same underlying 'weekdays' concept if the project treats the numeral as non-essential.
